verdict.rationale: Close's API is versioned in its path (/api/v1/) and has a published changelog of additive API changes, so the versioning half of the story has thin first-party evidence. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guarantees. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/compatibility guarantees, sunset/notice timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Opportunities now support a `note_html` field for rich text notes, alongside the existing plaintext `note` field.
